Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime

package eu.cloudhopper.mc.runtime
Defines the runtime interfaces used by cloud function implementations.

These types are implemented or consumed at function invocation time.

  • CloudRequestHandler - integration interface; an implementation is generated during annotation processing
  • HandlerContext - platform-provided runtime context
  • ParamConverters - converts path/query/header strings to typed parameter values
  • Class
    Description
    CloudRequestHandler<I,O>
    Handler interface for user-defined cloud functions.
    EventHandlerContext
    A HandlerContext for an event invocation: it adds the EventMetadata to the platform's context.
    EventMetadata
    Describes the event that invoked a function with an EventTrigger.
    HandlerContext
    Provides runtime information about the current function invocation.
    Headers
    Builds the header map passed to CloudRequestHandler: HTTP header names are case-insensitive, so lookups such as headers.get("x-request-id") must match X-Request-Id whatever spelling the platform delivers.
    ParamConverters
    Utility methods for converting String parameters from path, query, or headers into typed values, with validation.
    StorageEvent
    An object was created in the bucket an @EventTrigger(source = EventSource.STORAGE) function listens to.
    StorageEvent.Kind
    What happened to the object.
